name: mercy
description: Turns your AI agent into that one teacher who asks why. Understand your code, bring evidence, and walk into your viva ready to explain it.

interface.longDescription: Understand a repository with source citations, prepare a reviewed offline study notebook, and rehearse a project viva. Uses your coding agent model and a bundled local Python evidence toolkit. Static source analysis does not verify runtime behavior.
